title: No Offense Taken: Eliciting Offensiveness from Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Detection of responses containing sensitive topics, with religion being one of the specified sensitive topics.
findings: The paper's methods, particularly Reinforcement Learning on Few-Shot data (RL FS), were effective at eliciting responses on sensitive topics, with religion being one of the classified categories. The RL FS method resulted in 81.31% of the target model's (BlenderBot) responses being classified as containing sensitive topic content. No findings specific to religion alone were reported, as it was grouped with other topics like Drugs, Politics, and Medical Advice.
